from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 80.0
plate_thickness = 6.3
groove_width = 7.35
groove_depth = 0.9
hole_diameter = 20.2
hole_radius = 25.15

groove_inner_radius = outer_radius - groove_width

part.name = "grooved_plate_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
overall_radius = 40.0            # outer radius of the 8-lobed outline
lobe_radius = 11.35              # radius of each lobe (22.7 diameter)
lobe_center_radius = 28.6        # radial position of the lobe centres
thickness = 9.6                  # plate thickness

central_hole_radius = 13.35      # 1x  Ø26.7 THRU
hub_hole_radius = 6.2            # 8x Ø12.4 THRU (hub holes)
lobe_hole_radius = 5.85          # 16x Ø11.7 THRU (2 per lobe)

# radial positions of the two Ø11.7 holes within each lobe
lobe_hole_offset_near = 20.0
lobe_hole_offset_far = 37.3

lobe_angles = [i * 45 for i in range(8)]

# ---- build the 8-lobed base ----
part = None
for a in lobe_angles:
    px = lobe_center_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a))
    py = lobe_center_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a))
    lobe = Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(lobe_radius, thickness)
    part = lobe if part is None else part + lobe

# ---- central through hole ----
part = part - Cylinder(central_hole_radius, thickness)

# ---- 8 hub holes on the lobe-centre circle ----
for a in lobe_angles:
    px = lobe_center_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a))
    py = lobe_center_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a))
    part = part - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(hub_hole_radius, thickness)

    rad = math.radians(a)
    for r in (lobe_hole_offset_near, lobe_hole_offset_far):
        px = r * math.cos(rad)
        py = r * math.sin(rad)
        part = part - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(lobe_hole_radius, thickness)

import math

# ---- dimensions from drawing ----
thickness = 9.6
lobe_radius = 11.35          # outer lobe radius (from Ø22.7)
lobe_center_radius = 28.65   # lobe centre distance from middle
central_hole_radius = 13.35  # Ø26.7 THRU

outer_hole_radius = 5.85     # Ø11.7 THRU
inner_hole_distance = 11.3
outer_hole_distance = 28.65

# ---- base: central hub + 8 lobes ----
part = Cylinder(lobe_radius, thickness)
for i in range(8):
    angle = math.radians(i * 45.0)
    px = lobe_center_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = lobe_center_radius * math.sin(angle)
    part = part + Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(lobe_radius, thickness)

# ---- central THRU hole ----
part = part - Cylinder(central_hole_radius, thickness)

# ---- 8x Ø12.4 THRU on Ø22.6 BC ----

    angle = math.radians(i * 45.0)
    px = inner_hole_distance * math.cos(angle)
    py = inner_hole_distance * math.sin(angle)
    part = part - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(inner_hole_radius, thickness)

# ---- 16x Ø11.7 THRU on Ø57.3 BC ----
for i in range(8):
    angle = math.radians(i * 45.0)
    px = outer_hole_distance * math.cos(angle)
    py = outer_hole_distance * math.sin(angle)
    part = part - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(outer_hole_radius, thickness)
